name: ssvep
note: SSVEP (Nakanishi2015), 9 subjects, 8 occipital electrodes, 12 stimulation frequencies, 7-45 Hz over 0.5-3.5 s. Narrowband entrainment rather than band-power or evoked response -- the third distinct physics in this study. Only 180 trials per subject (15 per class), so this is a small, high-SNR cell: a failure here means something is genuinely wrong rather than merely noisy. The encoder's optional spectral STFT branch is built for exactly this narrowband structure and has never been tested on it.
